mode_inference_decision.rationale: The two isolated high-resolution horse views are transparent visual inputs for neural 3D reconstruction, not runtime sprites.

purpose: Two identity-matched original warhorse source references for the knight model stage; horse only, no rider or 3D delivery.
alpha_policy: genuine transparent alpha; exception to magenta chroma-key because direct RGBA is safer for neural mesh reconstruction
views: near-side near-profile orthographic, 15 degrees toward chest, head left
opposite-side near-profile orthographic, 15 degrees toward chest, head right
composition: one entire adult horse, four separate legs, both ears, four hooves and tail visible; at least 6 percent clear margin; no cast shadow or floor
style: original detailed stylized PBR medieval human-kingdom game art; chestnut brown coat, black mane and tail, functional leather tack, small kingdom-blue saddlecloth and aged brass dawn-sun emblem
postprocess: Original raw PNG copies are unchanged. Each candidate is the full 1536x1024 RGBA source uniformly resized to 1352x901 with Pillow Lanczos and alpha-composited at integer offset (92,61) onto a transparent 1536x1024 canvas. This changes framing only.
qa_gates: alpha bbox with at least 6 percent margin on each side
four separate legs and four hooves
identity, coat, mane, tack, saddlecloth and emblem match across views
no duplicate source or runtime publication
